demo.description: Reads all ticket context from local fixture files. No external systems are touched. Safe to present anywhere.

qase.note: Writing to Qase happens only after human review, via the separate /push-to-qase step (dry-run by default, --confirm to write).

real.description: Pulls live context from Jira/Confluence via the xp-developer-experience skills (netrc auth). Never commit real credentials or exported real data to this repo.
